name: Touch My Heart
source:
Main character is a prospective newly hired employee in a family restaurant. Besides the beauty manager there are six cute girls working there as waitresses. Learn to work, learn to love and conquer the heart of the girl you like!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-june-2001-no-reality.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角即将成为家庭餐厅的新员工。除了美丽的经理外，餐厅还有六名可爱的女服务员。学习工作，学习恋爱，征服你心仪女孩的心吧！

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-june-2001-no-reality.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
